platform_plan_id.description: PlatformPlan record that includes or offers this feature.

platform_feature_id.description: PlatformFeature record connected to this plan.

plan_feature_key.description: Stable unique key formatted as plan_key:feature_key.

feature_key.description: Copied PlatformFeature feature_key used for fast entitlement resolution.

is_included.description: True when this feature is included in the base plan.

default_limit_value.description: Default numeric limit provided by this plan.

is_add_on_available.description: True when this feature or an increased limit can be purchased as an add-on.

add_on_price_cents.description: Optional base price in cents for the add-on.

stripe_add_on_price_id.description: Stripe Price ID for the optional add-on.

is_active.description: Controls whether this feature-plan relationship can be used for new subscriptions.

sort_order.description: Display order in future plan-selection and administration screens.
